purpose: A declared service must deliver a value within a deadline; the theory side identifies computations by result equivalence (≈), which forgets the round index. Find whether each explicitly declared consumer preserves the original activity on every result-equivalent pair in the finite grammar.

source_basis.kind: independent calibration task over a pinned existing model
references: 理解章节/C11-HoTT理论经济账本与悖论位置判别-20260913.md rows #2 and #5

input.type_ref: ground terms of Delay Bool: ω or ret n b with n ≤ 2 (declared grammar)
input.available_information: only the pinned constructors and the consumers named below

environment.arrival_policy: synchronous rounds; later adds one round
environment.fairness: race is synchronous with left priority on ties

observation.trace: round index n is carried by ret but invisible to ≈
observation.time_structure: discrete synchronous rounds only; no continuity or physical-time claim

completion.criterion_ref: deadline k returns a value within k rounds; the race/business consumer terminates exactly when the delivered branch is accepted

allowed_resources: finite enumeration budget; native kernel checks for selected witnesses
prohibited_extra_information: no labels, hidden branch tags or oracle; deliver_business is declared before search
assumptions: the fragment is the pinned R041 delay model, not general partiality
deadline, raw race and race followed by deliver_business are separate declared consumers
no physical-time or implementation claim is made
obligations: every emitted witness and every control must belong to the declared grammar
observations and separation kinds are recomputed from pair and operations
task preservation requires a qualified profile and exact case/search/witness binding
a calibration instance must not be upgraded into a new mathematical claim

known_positive_controls.note: held as an external calibration benchmark; the enumerator does not receive it as a generated candidate

known_negative_controls.description: choose a declared deadline at or above both finite round indices; it must not separate the pair

correspondence.original_activity: a service whose separately declared observations are deadline delivery, raw race value, and race followed by the declared business continuation
theoryization_steps: model each branch as a single-thread deterministic delay
apply exactly one of the declared consumer shapes
correspondence.observation_justification: deadline reads the constructor round index; race reads completion order; deliver_business was declared before search
preservation_claims: the input domain, value type and declared observation are unchanged
no undeclared consumer or information source is introduced
open_obligations: a real consumer is outside this calibration
the physical reading of time is outside this fragment
